name: Erik Hunstad
biography: Erik Hunstad is a security expert and researcher who realized the power of programming and security when he coded an algorithm to reduce the search space of possible Master Lock combinations in RAPTOR. Erik is the CTO and Adversary Emulation Lead at SIXGEN where he specializes in deploying the latest offensive security techniques against customers. He previously worked for the Department of Defense. @SixGenInc
